name: CC0 Library
description: Free CC0 models, textures and skies from Poly Haven and ambientCG, fetched into your game with their licence recorded. No account or credits.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the CC0 libraries: Poly Haven's models, textures and HDRI skies, and ambientCG's materials. Free, no account. Any word may match a whole word of the name, tags or categories (a plural matches its singular): results matching more of your words come first, then name matches, then the most downloaded, so search with two or three plain nouns ('birch tree', 'snow ground'). Returns each result's source and id (what cc0__fetch takes), its name, authors, page, and for a model its triangles, budget (within, or over-import-cap past 250000) with a hint, and its size in millimetres. kind is model, texture or hdri (default texture); source narrows to polyhaven or ambientcg; limit is 1-24 (default 8). Search before generating a common prop, surface or sky.

query.description: Words to look for in the name, tags and categories, for example 'wooden crate' or 'brick wall'.

source.description: polyhaven or ambientcg; left out, both where they offer the kind.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one CC0 asset into this game's assets/cc0/<job>/ folder. Studio downloads it, checks its size and digests and records it as CC0-1.0 with its source; you never download anything yourself. A Poly Haven model arrives as one self-contained GLB (its maps embedded); a texture as its maps (default diff, nor_gl and arm on Poly Haven; diff, nor_gl, rough, ao and metal on ambientCG); an HDRI as one .hdr. source is polyhaven, ambientcg or curated (a hand-picked, sha256-pinned pack by its id). resolution is 1k, 2k or 4k (default 1k): fetch the size it is seen at, phones 1k. maps names extra or different texture maps, comma-separated: diff, nor_gl, nor_dx, arm, rough, ao, metal, disp. A model heavier than its tier's budget arrives decimated to it (the answer's decimated names the tier and the triangles before and after); the import step then adds its LODs, and a game draws far copies as an impostor (.with_impostor(Impostor::hemi())). Fetching the same asset, resolution and tier again lands in the same folder.

id.description: The id cc0__search returned, for example wooden_crate_01 or Bricks076C.

tier.description: A model's role, whose triangle budget the delivered GLB is decimated to when it is heavier: hero 250000, vegetation 40000, prop 30000, clutter 5000. Left out, only a model over the 250000 import cap is decimated, to it.

skills.name: cc0-library
skills.text: Free CC0 assets come from the CC0 Library: cc0__search finds Poly Haven models, textures and HDRI skies and ambientCG materials; cc0__fetch puts one into assets/cc0/<job>/ and records it as CC0-1.0 in the asset lock. Never download assets yourself or write licence rows by hand. Prefer a CC0 asset to generating a common prop, surface or sky. Asset routing (search and fetch before you generate, generate before you model): Props seen up close (furniture, vehicles, weapons, bins, crates): a CC0 model fetched with its tier (cc0__search kind model, then cc0__fetch tier), else genex__asset model (Tripo) with face-limit and auto-size; never stacked cubes, cones or spheres, flat colour, a picture standing in for 3D. Anything organic (trees, bushes, rocks, food): a CC0 model fetched with its tier (cc0__search kind model, then cc0__fetch tier), else genex__asset model (Tripo) with face-limit and auto-size; never stacked cubes, cones or spheres, flat colour, left over budget. Characters and creatures: genex__asset character or creature (Meshy, rigged); never stacked cubes, cones or spheres, a picture standing in for 3D. Surfaces (walls, floors, ground, bark, plating): a CC0 scan (cc0__fetch diff, nor_gl and arm at the size it is seen), else genex__asset texture for a subject-specific surface (terrain for ground); never flat colour. Leaf and grass cards, decals: genex__asset image with transparent; never flat colour. The sky: a CC0 HDRI (cc0__fetch kind hdri); never flat colour. A building's modular kit (walls, floors, frames, stairs, trim): blender__model with genex_bpy: gx.slab and gx.pbr from fetched scans, gx.bevel, gx.bake_atlas with wear; never flat colour. A model over its tier's budget: a CC0 model fetched with its tier (cc0__search kind model, then cc0__fetch tier), else blender__model with genex_bpy on the model: gx.decimate_to, gx.pbr, gx.bake_atlas; never left over budget. Tiers (triangles of LOD0): hero 250k, vegetation 40k, prop 30k, clutter 5k; cc0__fetch decimates a heavier model to its tier, and the import step any static model past 250k. Fetch at the size it is seen at (1k by default, 1k on phones, 2k for what fills the screen). A Poly Haven model arrives as one self-contained GLB, decimated to the tier you pass: load the returned path. A texture arrives as maps whose role (diff colour, nor_gl normal, arm occlusion/roughness/metalness) says how to sample it. Search results from Poly Haven carry the line Powered by Poly Haven; keep it next to them when you show them to the person.
